claims.statement: Every mixed 2+1 aggregate principal-triple determinant bank can be split into three disjoint original-coordinate banks retaining at least one half of its determinant mass.

In an exact-rank-three QFORM state, three disjoint spectral-rank-one original-coordinate banks carrying aggregate principal-triple determinant mass mu>0 give ||p_Q||_infinity <= 64 sqrt(10) mu^(-1/3), with arbitrary cap-one product laws and arbitrary conditioned outside couplings.
When the account03/B10 near-span O3 compiler supplies mixed determinant mass at least 1/256 and the resulting three resource banks are spectral-rank-one, the density bound is at most 512 sqrt(10).

Pay the remaining diffuse O3 three-bank packet when at least one resource-carrying bank has genuine spectral rank at least two, uniformly through the rank-one boundary and without selecting a vanishing physical minor.
